xy2-1.flavorText: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

attacks.name: Harden

abilities.name: Adaptive Evolution
abilities.text: This Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

xy2-2.flavorText: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

attacks.name: Quiver Dance
attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. If you attached Energy in this way, heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

xy2-3.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

xy2-4.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

xy2-5.flavorText: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

xy2-6.flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

attacks.name: Deranged Dance
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the number of Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

abilities.name: Leaf Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Grass Energy card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

xy2-7.flavorText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

xy2-8.flavorText: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.

attacks.name: Whiplash
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

xy2-9.flavorText: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.

attacks.name: Exciting Shake
attacks.text: During your next turn, flip 6 coins instead of 2 for this Pokémon's Prickly Needles attack.

attacks.name: Prickly Needles
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

xy2-10.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

xy2-14.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Overrun

xy2-15.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

xy2-16.flavorText: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

xy2-17.flavorText: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

xy2-18.flavorText: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

xy2-19.flavorText: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

abilities.name: Intimidating Mane
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Basic Pokémon.

xy2-20.flavorText: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

abilities.name: Counterattack Quills

xy2-21.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

xy2-22.flavorText: It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted streams and lakes. No one pays any attention to it.

abilities.name: Energy Grace
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack) you may Knock Out this Pokémon. If you do, attach 3 basic Energy from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon (excluding Pokémon-EX).

xy2-23.flavorText: Milotic is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

xy2-24.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy they clap fins.

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: Heal 60 damage from this Pokémon. This Pokémon is now Asleep.

xy2-25.flavorText: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Big Tusk

xy2-26.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

attacks.name: Heart Wink
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't draw a card at the beginning of his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Spike Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

xy2-27.flavorText: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

xy2-28.flavorText: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

attacks.name: Screw Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Stomp Off

xy2-30.flavorText: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

attacks.name: Frost Barrier

attacks.name: Shatter
attacks.text: Discard any Stadium card in play.

xy2-31.flavorText: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

attacks.name: Paralyzing Gaze

xy2-32.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

xy2-33.flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

attacks.name: Fang Snipe

attacks.name: Wild Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

xy2-34.flavorText: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey–even those taking shelter behind a wall.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Revival

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement

attacks.name: Confuse Ray

xy2-39.flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

attacks.text: Put damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon equal to the number of damage counters on this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Shadow Void
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to this Pokémon.

xy2-40.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

attacks.name: Spit Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

xy2-44.flavorText: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

attacks.name: Double-Edge

xy2-46.flavorText: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

xy2-47.flavorText: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

xy2-56.flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

attacks.name: Dark Clamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Double Swing
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage times the number of heads.

xy2-57.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

xy2-58.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

xy2-59.flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

attacks.name: Iron Crash

abilities.name: Thorn Tempest
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

xy2-60.flavorText: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

attacks.name: Chip Off
attacks.text: Discard cards from your opponent's hand at random until he or she has 4 cards in his or her hand.

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

xy2-61.flavorText: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

attacks.name: Aromatherapy
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

xy2-62.flavorText: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

xy2-63.flavorText: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

attacks.name: Petal Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

xy2-66.flavorText: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

attacks.name: Fickle Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

xy2-67.flavorText: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

attacks.name: Crystal Barrier
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Wonder Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Fairy Energy attached to this Pokémon.

xy2-68.flavorText: Born from temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

xy2-70.flavorText: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

attacks.name: Poison Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

abilities.name: Poison Barrier
abilities.text: Your opponent's Poisoned Pokémon can't retreat.

xy2-71.flavorText: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

attacks.name: Gooey
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

xy2-72.flavorText: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

attacks.name: Gooey
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

xy2-73.flavorText: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

attacks.name: Heavy Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

abilities.name: Gooey Regeneration
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

xy2-74.flavorText: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

attacks.name: Peck Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

xy2-75.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

attacks.name: Sand-Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

xy2-76.flavorText: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Strong Gust
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Strong Gust attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

xy2-77.flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

attacks.name: Triple Draw
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Sleepy Press
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon. This Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.name: Stir and Snooze
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Asleep, flip 2 coins instead of 1 between turns. If either of them is tails, this Pokémon is still Asleep.

xy2-80.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

xy2-81.flavorText: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.

attacks.name: Buried Treasure Hunt
attacks.text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

xy2-82.flavorText: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

attacks.name: Powerful Friends
attacks.text: If you have any Stage 2 Pokémon on your Bench, this attack does 70 more damage.

xy2-83.flavorText: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

attacks.name: Bounce
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

xy2-84.flavorText: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

attacks.name: Sitdown Bounce
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

abilities.name: Big Jump
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may return this Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

xy2-85.flavorText: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

xy2-86.flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

attacks.name: Tight Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

xy2-87.flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
